# Ramal Kthyb

Ramal Kthyb is the pale pink unicorn mare glimpsed at the Get On Inn in Somnambula during Trixie and Starlight Glimmer’s road trip in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. She is an exceptionally minor background pony, not the innkeeper.

- **Appearance:** Pale peach-pink coat, reddish-brown mane and muted gray-brown eyes. Her cutie mark is unverified.
- **Name and continuity:** Ramal Kthyb is an apparent fandom identification, not a verified spoken, credited or merchandise name. The date and origin of the name remain unconfirmed. The [unicorn character index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Unicorn_ponies) records her appearance at approximately 09:35 and notes that her design is shared with a mare from *Campfire Tales*; this is not evidence that they are the same character.
- **Speaking status:** Apparently silent; no individual dialogue or voice actor verified. No other appearances, alternate identities or comic roles confirmed.

## Important moments

- **At the crowded inn** — [Road to Friendship (S8E19)](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Road_to_Friendship), September 1, 2018. Her cameo is part of the crowded lodging scene in which the traveling friends fail to secure a room, adding to the strain on their friendship. A video timestamp could not be verified. This is her only documented scene; no independent character-defining decisions or dialogue were found.

## Images

The [episode screenshot gallery](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Road_to_Friendship/Gallery) includes the inn sequence (production: Hasbro/DHX Media). I could not verify an individual image asset depicting Ramal or attributed fan artwork, so no embedded image is included.
